annotations.title: Change how an action type is approved

description: Sets one action type (action_type, one of this workspace’s approval settings) to ask, auto_approve or auto_reject. An automatic mode needs risk_acknowledged true: on auto_approve every such action goes ahead with no person checking it. Refunds and the AI receptionist’s own actions (order.refund, payment.refund, receptionist.change, receptionist.payment) are refused here, in words: each automation that can refund, and the AI receptionist, sets its own. Only an owner or an admin may change it. Each change needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that says what would change and returns a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it changes.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

name: update_approval_settings
